record.title_md: [Open Problem (induced st-path of excess length three)](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.12273)

dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open Problem (induced st-path of excess length three)
dossier_meta.statement_text: Is there a polynomial-time algorithm to test whether a graph contains an induced path between specified vertices $s, t$ of length at least three more than the shortest $st$-path?
dossier_meta.context_text: Berger, Spirkl, and Seymour (including a co-author of the present paper) have a poly-time algorithm to detect an induced $st$-path longer than the shortest $st$-path. Whether a poly-time algorithm exists to detect one that is at least three longer remains open, as noted in the introduction.
